mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals immediate monetary easing that reduces short-term discount rates, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 6-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 6-month moving averages, or interaction term p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%) signal weak consumer spending and corporate profit pressures, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 105.0 signals manufacturing contraction and supply chain disruptions, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and real GDP (GDPC1) above 6-month moving averages indicates strong economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and GDPC1 exceed 6-month moving averages, or interaction term p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 250) signal central bank policy tightening that reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 250, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.
